title: midday-playbook-scratch-eden-2026-03-15
content:
MIDDAY PLAYBOOK - quick scratchpad (short, choppy)

Context: 11:30 standup went long, need to salvage afternoon. Goal = 6 meaningful touches (calls or demos booked) + 3 follow-up emails. Focus lists: churn-risk customers + two inbound MQLs.

TODAY PRIORITY CHECK (top to bottom)
- 1) Call: Brightleaf Media — Emma J. (AM) — Renewal Q + pricing push; priority HIGH (churn indicator: low usage last 14 days). Script bullets: 1) quick usage check, 2) highlight new batching optimizations (saves ~30% tokens), 3) ask about blockers for L2 rollout. Next step: send internal note to SE for deep dive if they ask for perf data. CRM: SFDC-789012.
- 2) Demo request: AtlasHealth (inbound via form) — CTO Jonah M. Timezone: PST; propose 3:30p PT today. Prep: quick perf slide (2 bullets), one-liner on private deploy options & KMS. Use demo lab: /confluence/demo-kits.
- 3) Reconnect: RedwoodLabs — procurement stalled. Contact: Priya K. Talk track: ROI calc + committed throughput pricing. Goal: get them to commit to pilot. If 'need legal', loop legal (Lina).
- 4) Outreach: 5 cold calls to target list (mid-market ecommerce). Quick opener: "we help product teams cut inference cost 30% while keeping latency SLOs". If positive: book discovery; if neutral: ask for tech lead intro.
- 5) Follow-ups: send tailored notes to leads from last week (A/B test subject lines: "quick question about inference costs" vs "redwood: latency + cost for LLMs"). Track opens in SFDC.

QUICK CALL LOG (scratch entries — fill after call)
- 12:05 Brightleaf Media / Emma J. — VM left: reference batching note + ask for 10-min sync. (status: left vm)
- 12:22 Quick cold call — no answer. Voicemail template used. (status: voicemail)
- 12:40 AtlasHealth — left message + DM on LinkedIn. (status: awaiting reply)

TEMPLATES / SCRIPTS (short)
- Voicemail: "Hi <name>, Eden at Redwood Inference. We recently helped a company similar to yours reduce per-token costs by ~25% while keeping p95 latency under 300ms. Quick 10-min chat to see if it makes sense? My calendar: [link]."
- Email follow-up (post-call no answer): short, 3 lines: 1) confirm left voicemail, 2) two-sentence value prop tailored to their case, 3) one CTA time suggestion.

NOTES TO SELF / ACTION ITEMS
- Add perf snippet for AtlasHealth: benchmark for 8k seq, batch size 16 (from bench-2026-02). Link to lab note: CONFLUENCE:/display/INF/8k-bench.
- Ask SE (Ravi) for a one-pager on Dedicated pricing tiers (we need a simple table to send to procurement).
- Update SFDC stage for Brightleaf to "at-risk — outreach" and set next task for 48h.
- Run a quick A/B of email subject lines using Outreach tool for next 50 outbound touches.

RISK FLAGS / THINGS TO WATCH
- If prospect asks specifically about on-prem + HSM latency, push to schedule 30m with solutions engineering (need Lina present).
- Legal terms: new enterprise clause for data retention — make sure we don't promise cust data deletion timeframe without legal OK.

END-OF-AFTERNOON CHECK (what to fill at EOD)
- Count of meaningful touches (calls that reached >2min or demos booked): _____
- Demos booked: _____ (names/time)
- Quick wins to escalate to AE manager: _____

RANDOM THOUGHTS / BRAIN DUMP
- Consider adding a "quick ROI card" to email templates: 3 numbers (cost delta, p95 latency, estimated time-to-prod). Could be a one-image card hosted in S3 + link.
- Try a short sequence targeting CTOs with a perf-first subject line for next week's experiments.

RELATED LINKS (for reference)
- Playbook: CONFLUENCE:/display/SELL/AE+Playbook
- Demo assets: DRIVE:/shared_drives/product/demo-kit-v2.pdf
- Bench notes: CONFLUENCE:/display/INF/8k-bench

UNRESOLVED QUESTIONS (to follow up)
- Does Dedicated pricing have a true "burst" cap for QPS? (ask billing/product)
- Are there any new trial limits for private deployments this month? (ops)

---
Tiny, fast, messy — will tidy into a proper follow-up email template later.
